item.title: Haiti U-20 men open FIFA World Cup qualifiers with 7-0, 4-0 lopsided victories
item.description: Haiti cruised past Anguilla and Saint Vincent to top Concacaf’s Group D early. Striker Nikolaï Pierre scored twice in each match while wingers Emerson Laissé and Franco Celestin overwhelmed defenders with their dribbling and crossing skills. item.title: Port-de-Paix residents welcome first fire truck in decades, hope service returns for good
item.description: Port-de-Paix has received its first fire truck in decades. The truck and an ambulance are part of a $3 million package from CPSOTA, a diaspora-linked nonprofit organization based in Montreal, to help rehabilitate and strengthen emergency services across Haiti. item.title: Haitian prime minister reshuffles cabinet after securing political backing
item.description: The 18-member cabinet includes five women and 13 men, maintaining the same level of female representation as the previous administration but falling short of the 30% quota mandated by Haiti’s 2012 constitutional amendment.
